question: The Ghodemodini dance is a folk dance form associated with ________.
solution:

__
 
• The** Ghodemodini dance** is a folk dance form that is associated with the** Indian state of Goa.**
 
• It is a traditional dance form that is performed during the **annual Shigmo festival,** which is celebrated in Goa during the** spring season.**
 
• The dance is performed by both **men and women**, who wear **colorful costumes** and dance to the beat of traditional Goan music.
 
• The movements of the Ghodemodini dance are inspired by the **movements of horses**, and the dancers often imitate the movements and gestures of these animals.
 
• The dance is believed to have originated in the **rural areas of Goa, **and it is a popular form of entertainment that is enjoyed by people of all ages.
